content: आक्षिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [अक्षेण दीव्यति जयति जितं वा; अक्ष ठक् <ls>P. IV. 4. 2.</ls>] .²1 One who plays at dice. .²2 One who uses loaded dice. (भारभूतानक्षानाहरति, वहति). .²3 One who gains by gambling. .²4 Won by gambling. .²5 Relating to dice or gambling; आक्षिकम् ऋणम् <ls>Ms. 8. 159</ls> incurred in gambling. .{@-कः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a tree (= अक्षिक <ab>q. v.</ab>) .{@-कम्@} .²1 Money gained by gambling. .²2 Gambling debt, money lost at play. .{@-की@} {%f.%} A kind of spirituous liquor prepared from the seeds of Teroninabia Bellerica (बिभीतक; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बेहडा</ns>).
